scientific_findings.title: A Facile Strategy Based on Ionic Liquids to Modulate the Antibacterial, Flame‐Retardant, and Sensing Properties of Cotton Fabrics
Flame retardant modification of waterborne polyurethane fabric coating agent with high hydrostatic pressure resistance

verification_limit: Four complete primary originals (45 native text pages) add six initial polyester textile states and six TG conditions; 28 factual records, 22 held. RSC supplementary-group LOI and Wiley experimental methods are unread after access failures; those records remain held. All accepted numbers and methods are explicit in primary originals.
